spans.s:
कैट a. Coming from an insect or
worm.

कैटभः N. of a demon killed by
Viṣṇu. [He was a very powerful
demon. He and Madhu are said to have
sprung from the ears of Viṣṇu while
he was asleep; and when they were
about to devour Brahman they were slain
by Viṣṇu].
--भा --भी An epithet of
Durgā.
--Comp.
--अरिः, --जित् m.,
--रिपुः, --हन् epithets of Viṣṇu.
